_README: App config — read by server/server.ts at boot, exposed (minus secrets) to the client via /api/config (server/routes/config.ts). JSON has no comments, so help text lives in `_*_help` keys; ignore them at runtime. Update one field at a time + restart the dev server (config is read once at boot).
_dataBackend_help: The agent talks to ONE data backend. Template ships with MAS → server/agent/refundops.ts registers `ask_mas` (server/agent/tools/mas.ts). For Genie-only demos: set genieSpaceId, clear masEndpointName, swap to askGenieTool in refundops.ts AgentContext + makeTools. For demos with both: register both factories with distinct names + tell the model in instructions when to prefer each.
_agentModel_help: Foundation Model serving endpoint that powers the OpenAI Agents loop (server/agent/refundops.ts → configureAgentsSdk). MUST be `databricks-gpt-5-4`. Why: the Agents SDK defaults to the OpenAI Responses API, which Databricks gates per-model. GPT-5-4 is the only Databricks-hosted model with `openai/v1/responses` enabled today — Anthropic models (Sonnet 4.6, etc.) return 400 BAD_REQUEST. Using anything other than GPT-5-4 will break the agent.
_mlflow_help: Two MLflow IDs land in the AppHeader (client/src/shell/AppHeader.tsx). `mlflowExperimentId` is a pinned legacy id (optional). `agentMlflowExperimentPath` auto-creates the experiment at boot via lib/mlflow.ts and is what the chat 'View trace' link points at — REQUIRED, or every assistant message shows 'Trace pending…' forever. Path format: /Users/<your-email>/<app-name>-agent-traces (unique per app).
_dashboard_help: AI/BI dashboard embedded as iframe on /dashboard route (client/src/dashboard/DashboardView.tsx). Set to the dashboard's UUID; remove the route + sidebar entry if your demo has none.
_data_help: Delta source for the one-shot Lakebase mirror sync at boot (server/db/sync.ts). The `tables` keys are domain-specific — they match the columns of TS types in client/src/shared/types.ts and Drizzle schema in server/db/schema.ts. When swapping the data model, update all three together. `customerPremium` is optional — set it to the ML predictions table from spec 03-ml-premium.md (e.g. `gold_customer_premium_predictions`) if your demo has a model; leave it as empty string to skip the predictions sync.
_branding_help: App name surfaces in the dock header + page titles. White-label here, not in code.
_assistantScript_help: Scripted demo chain — the dock's 'Suggested next' chip walks this list. First step is always available; subsequent steps unlock once the previous assistant message contains any of the `triggerAfter` substrings. Picker logic lives in client/src/chat/script.ts. Step 2 is the demo's load-bearing moment: the agent calls find_lot_premium_breakdown → quotes the labeled-vs-hidden split → drafts two emails (20% premium + 5% standard). Step 3 sends both with one bulk-tool call.

assistantScript.prompt: Why do I have so many returns?

Handle these affected customers. Use the premium classifier to pick who gets the bigger save — draft a 20% personal apology for premium customers (CS-tagged plus the ones the model finds) and a 5% goodwill for the rest. Show me both before sending.
Yes — send both and approve all the refunds.
